author: GamingBolt
description:
Well, we’ve finally got that look at Marvel’s Wolverine that we’ve been waiting so eagerly for. And while the story and combat are obviously great, there’s more to that showcase that makes this one a title that has us very optimistic. 

Insomniac has taken the time to understand the character, and translate that understanding into a title that brings him to life in a way that doesn’t lose out on his narrative potential, while allowing us to take control of a version of him that feels like we’re stepping into his shoes.

What is it about this one that has us already sold on its success? Join us as we gladly take you through our thoughts on a very memorable opening act for a State of Play event.
title: I'm Already Sold On Marvel's Wolverine, Here's Why...

author: GamingBolt
description:
When you initially hear about a spin-off to a popular franchise, it may not always spark the most interest. Case in point: all those rumors about Sony Santa Monica pursuing a new story starring Kratos' wife, Faye, combined with combat more in line with the older trilogy in terms of mobility and aggression. With the latest State of Play, the studio finally revealed its next entry in the long-running franchise with over 20 minutes of eye-watering gameplay. And there's no two ways about it – Laufey looks amazing.

And confusing, for many reasons. We start with the opening from the Norse saga's first chapter, where Kratos and Atreus cremate Faye and say their goodbyes. What comes next for them is an arduous journey spanning the Nine Realms and ultimately invoking Ragnarok. But far from a peaceful eternal rest, Faye awakens in an unknown land that we later learn is called the Everywhen. And this place is far more chaotic than what she's used to.
title: God of War Laufey - What The Hell Is Going On?

author: GamingBolt
description:
The latest State of Play has just concluded and it was quite a show. From release dates for several anticipated video games to brand new announcements, this State of Play was perhaps the best effort from PlayStation in years.

So, what were the best highlights? Let's check out 17 of the biggest game announcements from the latest State of Play.
title: 17 MASSIVE PS5 Game Reveals From State of Play That Dropped Everyone's Jaws
